history: Kohl has been used in the Arab world for thousands of years.
People believed it protected the eyes.
It was also used for beauty.
Children and adults both used kohl.
both genders used kohl, but it was more common for women.
Kohl was made from natural ingredients like lead sulfide, soot, and herbs.
Kohl was applied to the eyes using a thin stick.
Kohl was stored in small containers, often made of brass or silver.
Kohl was sometimes passed down through generations as a family heirloom.
Kohl was also used in other parts of the world, including India and North Africa.
Kohl was often associated with beauty and protection from the evil eye.
Kohl was sometimes used in traditional medicine to treat eye infections.
